root_cause: The Tabs component treats ArrowDown as a navigation key, moving focus to the next tab instead of leaving the current tab selected, which violates the expectation that only left/right arrows navigate between horizontal tabs.
repair_strategy: Add a keydown listener that prevents default for ArrowDown and ArrowUp keys when the target is a tab, preserving tab selection and panel visibility while retaining left/right arrow navigation.

edits.after:
<script type="module">
import { Tabs } from './packages/govuk-frontend/src/govuk/components/tabs/tabs.js'
new Tabs(document.getElementById('applications-tabs'))
</script>
<script>
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.target.matches('.govuk-tabs__tab') && (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowUp')) {
    e.preventDefault();
  }
});
</script>

expected_accessibility_effect: ArrowDown will no longer change focus or tab selection, ensuring keyboard navigation conforms to WCAG 2.1.1 (keyboard) and 2.4.3 (focus order) by limiting tab movement to left/right arrows only.
functional_risks: If the tab list were ever changed to a vertical orientation, ArrowDown/ArrowUp would be incorrectly suppressed.
Potential interference with any custom keydown handling that relies on ArrowDown/ArrowUp within tabs.
verification_requirements: Confirm that pressing ArrowDown while focused on any tab does not change focus, aria-selected attribute, or panel visibility.
Confirm that ArrowLeft and ArrowRight still correctly shift selection and update panels.
Ensure no JavaScript errors are introduced.
Verify that scrolling or other native behaviors remain unaffected.
